citations.claim: pre-impact upward velocity ~15 m/s near ceiling
post-impact downward velocity magnitude ~35 m/s, energy more than tripled
total energy at violation exceeds allowed limit

counterfactual.change: Changed bodies[0].vy from 17.16 to 2.0 (one field) so body does not reach ceiling within 626 steps; no boundary collision occurs and energy stays conserved, removing energy_bound violation.

explanation: Ceiling boundary collision injects energy: body approaches ceiling at ~15 m/s and rebounds at ~35 m/s, more than 2x speed, tripling kinetic energy. Even with e=0 the rebound still gains energy (409J vs ~220J initial), so restitution damping is not applied correctly and positional correction/impulse at the top wall adds outward velocity instead of removing it. Limiting the impact (lower initial vy so no ceiling hit within 626 steps) prevents the violation.
vision_note: Across steps 623 to 626 the violating blue body is pressed against the top boundary of the arena and shows almost no displacement between frames. At the violating step 626 it remains stuck at the ceiling instead of moving away from it. [disagreement: The numeric explanation claims a high-speed rebound off the ceiling from ~15 m/s to ~35 m/s which should be visible as a large downward displacement away from the ceiling after impact, but the image shows the body staying in contact with the ceiling with no visible rebound velocity across 623-626.]
